senses.en: the branch of geography that describes the natural features of the earth's surface

ex.en: Our geology course began with a unit on physiography and landforms.
ex.zh: 我們的地質學課程從自然地理學與地形單元開始。

root.note: 描寫自然地表的學問 → 自然地理學

senses.en: the study of how living things and their body parts function
the way an organism or body part functions

ex.en: She studied human physiology before applying to medical school.
ex.zh: 她在申請醫學院之前念了人體生理學。

root.note: 研究生物自然運作的學問 → 生理學

senses.en: the form, size, and development of a person's body

ex.en: The swimmer's powerful physique came from years of daily training.
ex.zh: 這位泳將強健的體格來自多年的每日訓練。

root.note: 身體的樣子 → 體格

senses.en: petty; of little value or importance

ex.en: The committee wasted an hour arguing over picayune details.
ex.zh: 委員會浪費了一小時爭論瑣碎的細節。

mn: 原指美國南方一種面額很小的硬幣，所以引申為「不值錢、瑣碎」。

senses.en: a small flute that plays notes an octave higher than an ordinary flute

ex.en: The bright sound of the piccolo rose above the whole marching band.
ex.zh: 短笛清亮的聲音蓋過了整個行進樂隊。

root.note: 小的長笛 → 短笛

senses.en: a part or portion of something
a single work of art, music, or writing

ex.en: Could you cut me a small piece of the chocolate cake?
ex.zh: 可以幫我切一小塊巧克力蛋糕嗎？

mn: a piece of pie：piece 裡面藏著 pie。

senses.en: gradually, one part at a time
done or made in stages rather than all at once

ex.en: The old house was renovated piecemeal over ten years.
ex.zh: 這棟老房子花了十年一點一點地整修完成。

root.note: 一份一份地 → 逐步地

senses.en: to rob a place using violence, especially in war
violent robbery, especially during war

ex.en: The invading army began to pillage every village along the river.
ex.zh: 入侵的軍隊開始掠奪沿河的每一個村莊。

senses.en: to attack or ridicule someone publicly
a wooden frame with holes for the head and hands, formerly used for public punishment

ex.en: The tabloids were quick to pillory the actor for one careless remark.
ex.zh: 八卦小報很快就因為那位演員一句無心的話而公開抨擊他。

mn: 古時候把犯人鎖在 pillory 上示眾讓人丟東西，所以引申為公開羞辱。

senses.en: a tool with two jaws used for gripping or pulling things
the front claws of a crab or lobster

ex.en: He used a pair of pincers to pull the rusty nail out of the board.
ex.zh: 他用一把鉗子把生鏽的釘子從木板上拔出來。

senses.en: a gripping tool; another form of "pincers"
senses.zh: 鉗子（pincers 的另一種說法）

senses.en: the claws of a crab or similar animal

ex.en: The crab raised its pinchers when the child got too close.
ex.zh: 小孩靠得太近時，螃蟹舉起了牠的螯。

root.note: 用來夾的東西 → 鉗子、螯

senses.en: the most successful or highest point
a tall pointed rock or mountain peak

ex.en: Winning the gold medal was the pinnacle of her athletic career.
ex.zh: 贏得金牌是她運動生涯的巔峰。

root.note: 尖尖的頂端 → 頂峰

senses.en: a person who is among the first to explore or develop something
to be the first to develop or use something

ex.en: She was a pioneer in the field of computer programming.
ex.zh: 她是電腦程式設計領域的先驅。

parts.m: foot soldier 步兵（古法文 peon）

root.note: 走在最前面開路的步兵 → 先驅

senses.en: deeply religious and devout
falsely showing moral superiority

ex.en: Her pious grandmother went to church every morning.
ex.zh: 她虔誠的祖母每天早上都去教堂。

parts.m: dutiful 盡本分的（拉丁文 pius）

root.note: 對神盡本分 → 虔誠的

senses.en: to stimulate interest or curiosity
a feeling of irritation or resentment from wounded pride

ex.en: The mysterious title was enough to pique my curiosity.
ex.zh: 那個神祕的標題足以激起我的好奇心。

mn: 常見片語 pique one's interest；和 peak（頂峰）、peek（偷看）同音別搞混。

senses.en: deserving or arousing pity

ex.en: The lost puppy let out a piteous cry in the rain.
ex.zh: 那隻走失的小狗在雨中發出可憐的哀鳴。

root.note: 引起憐憫的 → 可憐的

senses.en: deserving pity
deserving contempt; very poor in quality

ex.en: The refugees were living in pitiable conditions without clean water.
ex.zh: 難民生活在沒有乾淨水源的悲慘環境中。

root.note: 值得憐憫的 → 可憐的

senses.en: deserving or causing pity
very small or poor; contemptible

ex.en: The team made a pitiful attempt to score in the final minute.
ex.zh: 球隊在最後一分鐘做了一次差勁的得分嘗試。

root.note: 令人充滿憐憫 → 可憐的

senses.en: showing no pity; cruel

ex.en: The hikers struggled under the pitiless desert sun.
ex.zh: 健行者在無情的沙漠烈日下艱難前進。

root.note: 沒有憐憫 → 無情的

senses.en: a very small or inadequate amount of money

ex.en: The workers were paid a pittance for twelve hours of labor.
ex.zh: 工人辛苦工作十二小時卻只拿到微薄的工資。

senses.en: to make someone less angry or hostile

ex.en: The manager offered a free meal to placate the angry customer.
ex.zh: 經理提供免費餐點來安撫那位生氣的顧客。

root.note: 使平靜下來 → 安撫

senses.en: calm and peaceful; not easily upset

ex.en: We paddled across the placid lake just after sunrise.
ex.zh: 我們在日出後不久划船渡過平靜的湖面。

root.note: 平和安靜 → 平靜的

senses.en: the act of copying someone else's work or ideas and presenting them as one's own

ex.en: The student failed the course because of plagiarism in his final paper.
ex.zh: 那名學生因為期末報告抄襲而被當掉。

parts.m: kidnapper 綁架者（拉丁文 plagiarius）

root.note: 綁架別人的文字 → 抄襲

senses.en: a flat map of the sky or the earth, often with a rotating disk showing visible stars

ex.en: We used a planisphere to find the constellations visible that night.
ex.zh: 我們用星座盤找出當晚看得到的星座。

root.note: 把球體畫在平面上 → 平面天體圖

senses.en: the quality of being easily shaped or molded
the ability of the brain or an organism to adapt and change

ex.en: The plasticity of a child's brain makes learning languages easier.
ex.zh: 孩童大腦的可塑性讓學習語言更容易。

root.note: 能被塑造的性質 → 可塑性

senses.en: a remark that has been used too often to be interesting

ex.en: The speech was one platitude after another and offered no real solutions.
ex.zh: 這場演講一句接一句都是陳腔濫調，沒有提出任何真正的解決辦法。

ex.en: "Everything happens for a reason" is a common platitude.
ex.zh: 「凡事發生必有原因」是一句常見的老生常談。

root.note: 平淡無奇的話 → 陳腔濫調

senses.en: praise or enthusiastic approval (usually plural)

ex.en: The young director earned plaudit after plaudit for her first film.
ex.zh: 這位年輕導演的第一部電影讓她獲得一次又一次的讚揚。

root.note: 拍手叫好 → 讚揚（applaud 同源）

senses.en: seeming reasonable or probable

ex.en: His excuse sounded plausible, so the teacher accepted it.
ex.zh: 他的藉口聽起來合理，所以老師接受了。

root.note: 值得拍手認同的 → 看似合理的

senses.en: fond of games and fun; lighthearted
senses.zh: 愛玩的；鬧著玩的；開玩笑的

ex.en: The playful kitten chased a ball of yarn around the room.
ex.zh: 那隻愛玩的小貓在房間裡追著一團毛線跑。

root.note: 充滿玩心 → 愛玩的

senses.en: a person who writes plays

ex.en: The playwright rewrote the final scene after the first rehearsal.
ex.zh: 劇作家在第一次排練後重寫了最後一幕。

root.note: 製作戲劇的人 → 劇作家

mn: wright 是「工匠」不是 write，所以拼成 playwright 不是 playwrite。

senses.en: an urgent, emotional request
a formal statement in court of guilty or not guilty
senses.zh: （法庭上的）答辯；認罪與否的聲明

ex.en: The mayor made a plea for residents to conserve water.
ex.zh: 市長懇請居民節約用水。

senses.en: giving a sense of enjoyment; agreeable
friendly and polite

ex.en: We had a pleasant afternoon walking along the beach.
ex.zh: 我們沿著海灘散步，度過了愉快的下午。

root.note: 令人高興的 → 愉快的

senses.en: giving pleasure; enjoyable

ex.en: Reading on a rainy day is a simple but pleasurable habit.
ex.zh: 在雨天看書是個簡單卻令人愉快的習慣。

root.note: 能帶來樂趣的 → 令人愉快的

senses.en: of or belonging to the common people; unrefined
a member of the common people, originally in ancient Rome

ex.en: The snobbish critic dismissed pop music as plebeian entertainment.
ex.zh: 那位勢利的評論家把流行音樂斥為平民的娛樂。

parts.m: common people 平民（拉丁文 plebs）

root.note: 屬於平民的 → 平民的、粗俗的

senses.en: a person to whom something is pledged as security for a loan

ex.en: The pledgee may keep the jewelry until the loan is repaid.
ex.zh: 在借款償還之前，受質人可以保管這些珠寶。

root.note: 接受抵押品的人 → 受質人

senses.en: a person who pledges property as security for a loan (usually spelled pledgor)

ex.en: The pledgeor handed over his watch as security for the loan.
ex.zh: 出質人交出手錶作為借款的擔保。

root.note: 提供抵押品的人 → 出質人

senses.en: (of a meeting) attended by all members
unqualified; absolute

ex.en: The final decision will be made at the plenary session tomorrow.
ex.zh: 最後的決定將在明天的全體會議上做出。

root.note: 人數滿的、完整的 → 全體的

senses.en: a diplomat given full power to act for a government
having full power to take independent action

ex.en: The king sent a plenipotentiary to negotiate the peace treaty.
ex.zh: 國王派出一位全權代表去談判和約。

root.note: 擁有完整權力的人 → 全權代表

senses.en: an abundance; a large amount
the condition of being full or complete

ex.en: The market offered a plenitude of fresh fruit in summer.
ex.zh: 夏天的市場上有大量新鮮水果。

root.note: 滿滿的狀態 → 豐富

senses.en: plentiful; abundant (literary)
senses.zh: 豐富的；充足的（文學用語）

ex.en: The farmers gave thanks for a plenteous harvest.
ex.zh: 農夫們為豐盛的收成感恩。

root.note: 充足的 → 豐富的

senses.en: to explore or understand something completely
exactly vertical
exactly; completely (informal)

ex.en: The novel tries to plumb the depths of human loneliness.
ex.zh: 這部小說試圖探究人類孤獨的深處。

root.note: 用綁鉛的繩子測深度、測垂直 → 探究、垂直的

mn: b 不發音；plumber（水管工）也來自鉛，因為古時水管是鉛做的。

senses.en: to fall or drop straight down very quickly

ex.en: Temperatures can plummet at night in the desert.
ex.zh: 沙漠裡的氣溫在夜間可能驟降。

root.note: 小鉛錘直直往下掉 → 暴跌

senses.en: (grammar) the past perfect tense
the past perfect tense, as in "had eaten"

ex.en: "She had left" is an example of the pluperfect tense.
ex.zh: 「她已經離開了」是過去完成式的例子。

root.note: 比完成更往前 → 過去完成式

senses.en: (grammar) referring to more than one
the plural form of a word

ex.en: The plural form of "mouse" is "mice."
ex.zh: mouse 的複數形是 mice。

root.note: 不只一個 → 複數的

senses.en: the largest number of votes when no one has a majority
a large number or variety

ex.en: She won with a plurality of the vote, but not a majority.
ex.zh: 她以相對多數票勝選，但沒有過半。

root.note: 較多的狀態 → 相對多數

mn: majority 是過半數；plurality 只是比別人多，不一定過半。

senses.en: government by the wealthy; a society ruled by the rich

ex.en: Critics warned that the country was becoming a plutocracy.
ex.zh: 批評者警告這個國家正在變成財閥統治。

root.note: 由財富統治 → 財閥政治

senses.en: filled with or operated by air or gas under pressure

ex.en: The mechanic used a pneumatic drill to remove the bolts.
ex.zh: 技師用氣動鑽拆下螺栓。

root.note: 靠空氣運作的 → 氣動的

mn: p 不發音；pneumonia（肺炎）也是同一個字根。

senses.en: poetry or the art of writing poetry (archaic)

ex.en: The old book praised the beauty of pastoral poesy.
ex.zh: 那本舊書讚美田園詩歌之美。

parts.m: make, create 創作（希臘文 poiein）

root.note: 創作 → 詩

senses.en: a person who writes poor or trivial poetry

ex.en: The critic called him a mere poetaster with no real talent.
ex.zh: 評論家說他只是個沒有真正才華的蹩腳詩人。

root.note: 低劣的詩人

senses.en: relating to or like poetry; beautifully expressive

ex.en: Her description of the sunset was almost poetic.
ex.zh: 她對夕陽的描寫幾乎充滿詩意。

root.note: 像詩的 → 富有詩意的

mn: poetic justice：因果報應、惡有惡報。

senses.en: the study or theory of poetry and literary form

ex.en: Aristotle's Poetics is one of the oldest works of literary theory.
ex.zh: 亞里斯多德的《詩學》是最古老的文學理論著作之一。

root.note: 研究詩的學問 → 詩學

senses.en: the quality of evoking a strong sense of sadness or regret

ex.en: The poignancy of the final scene left the audience in tears.
ex.zh: 最後一幕的辛酸讓觀眾都流下眼淚。

root.note: 刺痛人心的性質 → 辛酸

senses.en: evoking a keen sense of sadness or regret; deeply moving
senses.zh: 令人心酸的；深深感人的

ex.en: The letter from the soldier to his mother was deeply poignant.
ex.zh: 那名士兵寫給母親的信非常令人心酸。

root.note: 刺痛人心的 → 令人心酸的（pungent 同源）

senses.en: graceful and elegant bearing; calm self-confidence
to be or keep balanced; to be ready to act

ex.en: She answered the difficult questions with remarkable poise.
ex.zh: 她以驚人的沉著回答了那些困難的問題。

mn: be poised to...：蓄勢待發、準備好要…。

senses.en: relating to the North or South Pole
completely opposite

ex.en: Polar bears depend on sea ice to hunt seals.
ex.zh: 北極熊依賴海冰來獵捕海豹。

root.note: 極的 → 極地的、兩極的

senses.en: the practice of strong written or spoken attack or argument

ex.en: The debate quickly turned from reasoned discussion to angry polemics.
ex.zh: 這場辯論很快就從理性討論變成憤怒的論戰。

root.note: 用言語打仗 → 論戰

senses.en: a fine powder produced by flowers that fertilizes other plants

ex.en: Bees carry pollen from one flower to another.
ex.zh: 蜜蜂把花粉從一朵花帶到另一朵花。

senses.en: to make air, water, or land dirty or harmful
to corrupt morally

ex.en: Factories must not pollute the river with chemical waste.
ex.zh: 工廠不得用化學廢料污染河川。

senses.en: government by many people

ex.en: The political scientist described modern democracy as a form of polyarchy.
ex.zh: 那位政治學者把現代民主描述為一種多元政體。

root.note: 多人統治 → 多頭政治

senses.en: government by many rulers

ex.en: After the king died, the empire fell into a weak polycracy of rival lords.
ex.zh: 國王死後，帝國陷入由敵對領主共治的脆弱多頭政治。

root.note: 多人統治 → 多頭政治

senses.en: the practice of having more than one spouse at the same time

ex.en: Polygamy is illegal in most countries.
ex.zh: 多配偶制在大多數國家是違法的。

root.note: 多重婚姻 → 多配偶制

senses.en: a person who knows and uses several languages
knowing or written in several languages

ex.en: A true polyglot, the tour guide switched easily between six languages.
ex.zh: 那位導遊是真正的多語人才，能在六種語言之間輕鬆切換。

root.note: 很多條舌頭 → 通曉多種語言

senses.en: a flat shape with three or more straight sides

ex.en: A hexagon is a polygon with six sides.
ex.zh: 六邊形是有六個邊的多邊形。

root.note: 很多角的圖形 → 多邊形

senses.en: a solid shape with many flat faces

ex.en: A cube is a polyhedron with six square faces.
ex.zh: 立方體是有六個正方形面的多面體。

root.note: 很多面的立體 → 多面體

senses.en: a word of more than three syllables

ex.en: "Responsibility" is a polysyllable that young readers often stumble over.
ex.zh: responsibility 是年幼讀者常唸不順的多音節字。

root.note: 多個音節的字

senses.en: a college offering courses in many technical and applied subjects
teaching many technical subjects

ex.en: He studied engineering at a polytechnic in Hong Kong.
ex.zh: 他在香港一所理工學院念工程。

root.note: 教多種技術的 → 理工學院

senses.en: the belief in or worship of more than one god

ex.en: Ancient Greek religion was a form of polytheism.
ex.zh: 古希臘宗教是一種多神信仰。

root.note: 信奉多個神 → 多神論

senses.en: the raised front part of a saddle, or the knob at the end of a sword handle
to beat repeatedly with the fists (variant of pummel)

ex.en: The rider grabbed the pommel of the saddle as the horse jumped.
ex.zh: 馬跳起來時，騎士抓住了鞍頭。

root.note: 像小蘋果的圓頭 → 劍柄頭、鞍頭

mn: 體操的 pommel horse 就是「鞍馬」。

senses.en: the quality of being self-important and pretentious

ex.en: The speaker's pomposity made it hard to take his ideas seriously.
ex.zh: 講者的自大浮誇讓人很難認真看待他的想法。

root.note: 擺排場的性質 → 浮誇

senses.en: acting in a self-important, grand, or pretentious way
senses.zh: 自大的；浮誇的；愛擺架子的

ex.en: The pompous official insisted that everyone call him "Your Excellency."
ex.zh: 那位自大的官員堅持大家要叫他「閣下」。

root.note: 愛擺排場的 → 浮誇的

senses.en: to think about something carefully

ex.en: Take a moment to ponder the question before you answer.
ex.zh: 回答之前，花點時間仔細思考這個問題。

root.note: 在心裡秤一秤 → 仔細考慮

senses.en: slow and clumsy because of great weight
dull, labored, and boring

ex.en: The elephant moved with ponderous steps toward the water.
ex.zh: 大象邁著沉重的步伐走向水邊。

root.note: 很重的 → 笨重的、沉悶的

senses.en: the Pope
a high priest or chief religious leader

ex.en: Thousands gathered in the square to hear the pontiff speak.
ex.zh: 數千人聚集在廣場聽教宗講話。

root.note: 造橋者（連接人與神的人）→ 大祭司、教宗

senses.en: the people living in a particular country or area; the general public

ex.en: The new law was popular with the general populace.
ex.zh: 新法律受到一般民眾的歡迎。

root.note: 一般人民 → 民眾

senses.en: having a large population; densely populated
senses.zh: 人口眾多的；人口稠密的

ex.en: Tokyo is one of the most populous cities in the world.
ex.zh: 東京是世界上人口最多的城市之一。

root.note: 人很多的 → 人口眾多的

senses.en: to be a sign or warning that something, often bad, will happen

ex.en: Dark clouds on the horizon seemed to portend a storm.
ex.zh: 地平線上的烏雲似乎預示著暴風雨。

root.note: 向前伸出指向未來 → 預示

senses.en: a sign or warning that something, especially bad, is about to happen

ex.en: Some villagers saw the comet as a portent of disaster.
ex.zh: 有些村民把彗星視為災難的預兆。

root.note: 向前伸出的指示 → 預兆

senses.en: a set of pieces of creative work collected to show someone's ability
a range of investments held by a person or organization
the area of responsibility of a government minister

ex.en: She brought her portfolio of drawings to the art school interview.
ex.zh: 她帶著自己的素描作品集去參加美術學校的面試。

root.note: 攜帶紙張的夾子 → 作品集

senses.en: to put forward as a fact or basis for argument

ex.en: Some scientists posit that life may exist on other planets.
ex.zh: 有些科學家假定其他星球上可能存在生命。

root.note: 把論點擺出來 → 假定

senses.en: a place where someone or something is
a job or a point of view
to put something in a particular place

ex.en: She applied for a position at a large law firm.
ex.zh: 她應徵了一家大型律師事務所的職位。

root.note: 被放置的地方 → 位置

senses.en: hopeful and confident; good or useful
completely certain
(of a test) showing the presence of something

ex.en: Try to keep a positive attitude even when things go wrong.
ex.zh: 即使事情出錯，也試著保持積極的態度。

root.note: 明確放下、確立的 → 肯定的、正面的

senses.en: a group of people gathered by a sheriff to help catch a criminal
a group of friends or followers (informal)

ex.en: In the old western, the sheriff formed a posse to chase the bandits.
ex.zh: 在那部老西部片裡，警長組了一支民團追捕土匪。

parts.m: be able 能夠（拉丁文 posse comitatus）

root.note: 郡裡有權力的人 → 民團

senses.en: to have or own something
(of a feeling or spirit) to control someone's mind

ex.en: Very few people possess the patience to become great teachers.
ex.zh: 很少人擁有成為優秀老師所需的耐心。

parts.m: able, master 有能力的主人（拉丁文 potis）

root.note: 以主人身分坐在上面 → 擁有

senses.en: the state of having or owning something
something that is owned

ex.en: The old photo album was her most treasured possession.
ex.zh: 那本舊相簿是她最珍貴的東西。

root.note: 擁有的狀態或東西

senses.en: demanding someone's total attention and love; unwilling to share
(grammar) showing ownership

ex.en: He became possessive and got angry whenever she talked to other friends.
ex.zh: 他變得佔有慾很強，只要她和別的朋友說話就生氣。

root.note: 想要擁有的 → 佔有慾強的

senses.en: a person who owns or has something

ex.en: She is the proud possessor of a first-edition copy of the novel.
ex.zh: 她很自豪地擁有這本小說的初版。

root.note: 擁有的人

senses.en: able to be done or to happen

ex.en: Is it possible to finish the project by Friday?
ex.zh: 有可能在星期五前完成這個專案嗎？

root.note: 能夠做到的 → 可能的

senses.en: to write a later date on a document than the actual date
senses.zh: （在文件上）填寫比實際晚的日期

senses.en: to happen or exist later than something else

ex.en: You can postdate the check so it cannot be cashed until next month.
ex.zh: 你可以在支票上填寫較晚的日期，這樣下個月才能兌現。

root.note: 填寫較晚的日期

senses.en: further back in position; at the rear
a person's buttocks (humorous)

ex.en: The posterior part of the brain processes visual information.
ex.zh: 大腦後部負責處理視覺訊息。

root.note: 比較後面的 → 後部的

senses.en: relating to study done after a first college degree
senses.zh: 研究所的；大學畢業後的

senses.en: a student taking such a course

ex.en: She plans to do postgraduate research in marine biology.
ex.zh: 她打算在研究所做海洋生物學的研究。

root.note: 畢業之後的 → 研究所的

senses.en: an extra note added at the end of a letter (P.S.)
a later addition to a story or event

ex.en: In a postscript, she added that she missed everyone.
ex.zh: 她在附言裡補充說她很想念大家。

root.note: 寫在後面的 → 附言

senses.en: power or strength, especially of a drug or argument

ex.en: The medicine loses its potency if it is stored in heat.
ex.zh: 這種藥如果存放在高溫下會失去藥效。

root.note: 有力量的性質 → 效力

senses.en: having great power, influence, or effect
senses.zh: 強有力的；有效的；（藥、酒）強烈的

ex.en: Fear can be a potent motivator.
ex.zh: 恐懼可能是很強大的動力。

root.note: 有力的

senses.en: a ruler with great power, especially an absolute one

ex.en: The ancient potentate ruled his kingdom without any council.
ex.zh: 那位古代君主不設任何議會就統治他的王國。

root.note: 有權力的人 → 君主

senses.en: having the ability to develop into something in the future
qualities that may develop and lead to future success

ex.en: The coach saw great potential in the young player.
ex.zh: 教練在這位年輕球員身上看到很大的潛力。

root.note: 有能力成為… → 潛在的

senses.en: a liquid drink with medicinal, magical, or poisonous properties

ex.en: In the story, the witch gave the prince a sleeping potion.
ex.zh: 故事裡，女巫給了王子一瓶安眠藥水。

root.note: 喝的東西 → 藥水

senses.en: without ability, influence, or power

ex.en: We felt powerless as the flood waters rose around the house.
ex.zh: 洪水在房子四周上漲時，我們感到無能為力。

root.note: 沒有力量 → 無能為力

senses.en: able to be done or put into practice successfully

ex.en: Building a bridge across the bay is not practicable at this cost.
ex.zh: 以這樣的成本在海灣上建橋並不可行。

root.note: 可以實行的 → 可行的

mn: practicable 是「做得到」；practical 是「實用的、務實的」。

senses.en: to talk foolishly or at length about something

ex.en: He would prate for hours about his youth without letting anyone speak.
ex.zh: 他會一連好幾個小時嘮叨他年輕時的事，不讓別人插話。

senses.en: to talk at length in a foolish or childish way
senses.zh: 喋喋不休地閒聊；說孩子氣的話

senses.en: foolish or childish talk

ex.en: The children began to prattle excitedly about their trip to the zoo.
ex.zh: 孩子們開始興奮地嘰嘰喳喳聊著去動物園的事。

root.note: 一直閒扯 → 喋喋不休
